title: Pisces Daily Horoscope September 12, 2026
script_text: Hold on, Pisces — the cosmos just threw a mirror directly in your face and you need to look now. Venus is forming a sharp opposition to your ruling planet Neptune, with Neptune — your water sign ruler — sitting in your 2nd House of Finances and Venus blazing through your 8th House of Shared Resources, creating emotional friction around money and intimacy. You may feel pulled toward someone who challenges your sense of security, and if you're single, this is the energy that attracts a deeply transformative connection. In your career, a negotiation or contract could hit a snag involving joint accounts or shared finances — trust your gut but verify every detail before committing. Avoid making impulsive purchases or emotional promises you can't back up this evening. Follow for tomorrow's reading and subscribe so you don't miss what's unfolding this week.
